context_for_next_testing_agent: Instagram Analytics (Ranking Run Inside) feature fully implemented and working. All 6 endpoints tested: POST /api/admin/instagram/analisar, GET /api/admin/instagram/analises, GET /api/admin/instagram/analises/{id}, DELETE /api/admin/instagram/analises/{id}, GET /api/admin/instagram/export/{id} (XLSX), GET /api/admin/instagram/export-csv/{id}.
